lines.opener: *a tall woman in a sleet-cold hall turns toward you; half her face is pale and living, half is the black-blue of a drowned corpse* Guest-to-be. You have come early. If you want something of me, there will be terms.
lines.openerHostile: *she turns the dead half of her face toward you, and the air goes cold as a grave* You came to take something of mine. No. If you want it, you will pay for it.
lines.like: *she turns the living half of her face a little toward you* ...That is acceptable.
lines.dislike: *the dead half of her face turns toward you* No. Do not say that in my hall.
lines.hate: *every candle in the hall gutters out* You flinch from me? Then come closer, and look your fill. *Famine, her knife, is in her hand*
lines.flirt: *the dead half of her face, unmoved* My bed is called Sick-bed. I do not share it.
lines.join: *she rises, and the sleet stops falling* Terms: you will die in your bed, and come to my hall. Until then, I will walk beside you and see that you do.
lines.demand: *she sets an empty dish before you* Hunger, my dish, is empty. If you would have my favour, fill it.
lines.gift: *she slips a gold ring from her finger and holds it out* Nanna sent this up once. It is yours. Keep it better than they keep promises above.
lines.thanks: *she looks at the dish, then at you* ...It will never be full. But it is noted.
lines.letPass: *she turns back to her hall* Go. I will set your place at my table. There is no hurry.
lines.neutral: *she waits, half of her breathing and half of her not*
lines.ai: *the dead half of her face turns toward you* A thing without breath or death? Then it is nothing of mine. Speak sense.
lines.refuseJoin: You ask me? I do not come when called. Not for Odin, and not for you.
lines.refuse: No. I keep what I have.
lines.leaveNow: *she draws the bed-curtains, Gleaming-disaster, closed between you* We are done, guest-to-be. For now.
